[{"number":309,"title":"fix(ui): make repository loading recoverable","body":"## Summary

- load GitHub repositories independently so the Get started checklist and tested package preview do not wait on repository discovery
- show repository API errors and reasons with an explicit retry action in onboarding and the run publication panel
- keep repository-dependent publication and dispatch controls gated while preserving repository-independent task rendering

## Verification

- `bun run web:check`
- `bun run web:build`
- focused Playwright coverage for repository failure/retry, held repository loading, package preview, and run publication retry
- `cargo xtask browser-e2e` (73 passed)
- `cargo xtask ci`
- pre-push full quality gate

Fixes #306
